messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man walks slowly forward toward the camera, then stops and turns his head to look up and to his left.","camera":"A vertical, eye-level full-body shot that slowly dollies in to a medium shot as the subject approaches.","clothing":"A pink and white plaid three-piece suit (jacket, vest, and trousers) over a white collared shirt with a bright blue tie, and black shoes.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short black hair with a small top-knot or bun at the crown.","identity":"A 3D-rendered young man with dark skin, a slim build, and a short beard.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy, reflective floor, dark dome-shaped buildings with glowing teal lights, and a purple tram in the background under a cloudy blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from an underpass/road scene to the reference's futuristic plaza with reflective floor, dark dome buildings, glowing teal lights, and a purple tram. The man's forward walking action and dolly-in framing are largely preserved, and his lighting now includes cool/pink environmental tones. However, his suit changed from a brown/tan plaid pattern to a pink/white plaid pattern, and his tie changed from dark/black to bright blue.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source scene with the futuristic environment from the reference image while preserving the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, and adapt the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial identity and expression were fully preserved despite lighting and rendering changes
unexpected_changes: Suit color/pattern changed from brown-tan plaid to pink-white plaid
Tie changed from dark/black to bright blue
Overall image appears brighter and more saturated than the source
